sections.excerpt:

dividend of $0.03 per share. We do not presently have a plan to pay regular cash dividends on our Class A Common Stock in the future. We currently anticipate that we will retain all future earnings for the operation of our business. Payment of
future cash dividends, if any, will be at the discretion of our Board after taking into account various factors, including our financial condition, operating results, the current and anticipated cash needs, outstanding indebtedness, plans for
